_comment: Tunable economy values (prototype). Coins are soft currency only - no real money.

rewards._v06: Level 200 (Grand Master) pays its own bonus once; milestones 125 / 150 / 175 pay a one-time bonus.

_chapter_multiplier: Level rewards scale with the Chapter. Chapters past the list add 'step' per Chapter up to 'max'.
_chest_tiers: One Chapter chest that upgrades with the Chapter's stars (30 possible). Each tier is claimed once.
_reward_blocks: Coins for escaping a special block by normal play. Each block pays once per save; a Hammer smash pays nothing. 'from_level' is where the campaign starts using it. Diamond is reserved (disabled).
